title: the-cheapest-reader-rehearses-a-ticket-before-buildme

decisions.text: A ticket is measured buildable before BUILDME: the cheapest model reads the ticket plus its prebuild, cold, three times, and returns a typed build tree; the crossing is held until the trees agree and every gap is a decision on the ticket or a question in the inbox.
decisions.by: Akien verbatim 2026-09-15: 'We run an agent with the ticket, ask for it's proof tree, simplify or get questions answered, then try again until it passes that gate. All on the cheapest model. and after the prebuild.'

decisions.text: The reader's job is the tree, never code; cannot_proceed is a right answer, not a failure.
decisions.by: Akien verbatim 2026-09-15: 'tell haiku that it's job is to build out it's tree, not to produce code. so not possible is not a fail but another right answer.'

decisions.text: The machine lives at cairn/machines/rehearsal/ — rehearsal.py, prompt.md, schema.json, probes/, proofs/, intention+why.json (written at cast).

decisions.text: The reader's only input is the ticket JSON and its standing chart berths (skills.chart.live chain <ticket>) rendered as text, plus the charters named in orient's refs. No repo access.
decisions.by: Akien verbatim 2026-09-15: 'we hand the agent the prebuild which we can run without llm' + CC's reading accepted 'agreed on all counts': a cannot_proceed naming a file the survey did not list is a finding against the survey leg

decisions.text: The output schema (schema.json): {ticket, ticket_sha256, read: 1..3, nodes: [{step, state in {builds_as_written, builds_under_assumption, cannot_proceed}, assumption, would_settle, confidence 0..1}]}. A read that fails the schema is re-read, not a gap.
decisions.by: CC at cast 2026-09-15 (three legal node states, accepted 'agreed on all counts'); sorted berth /home/akien/.cairn/devices/skill_block/0/berths/sorted/sorted-20260915T101711-f7e30718c43c.json

decisions.text: A gap is deterministic: any node not builds_as_written in any read; any step present in one read and absent in another after case-folding through cairn.tools.system_word; any two reads whose assumption text differs on the same step.
decisions.by: Akien verbatim 2026-09-15 (Haiku's comparative reading, carried in his prose): 'Every place they diverge is a gap' + memory system-words-fold-case

decisions.text: The transport is `claude -p --model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 --output-format json` as a subprocess; a cheaper transport (plain API or the inference proxy) is a follow-on ticket, not this build.

decisions.text: The ticket hash is sha256 of the ticket file bytes at read time, recorded on the rehearsal; the lane compares it to the live file, so an edited ticket is un-rehearsed again.
decisions.by: CC at cast 2026-09-15; derived from CLAUDE.md Law 3 (nothing is known until measured — a rehearsal of other bytes measures nothing)

decisions.text: The gate is 'no reader has to assume', never 'Haiku's build is the build'; after PROVED the built proof is diffed against the converged tree and the divergence list is written onto the rehearsal record (the WATCHME probe the_rehearsal_predicts_the_build, enough at eight clean of ten).
decisions.by: Akien verbatim 2026-09-15: 'let me check one assumption: in almost all cases, anything haiku can build, opus will be able to build as well' — agreed likely, instrumented rather than trusted

decisions.text: No proof tooth calls the real reader; proofs stub it with recorded trees. The live Haiku call is the live fire.
decisions.by: derived from memory hollow-worktree-has-no-commons-beside (a live fire inside a proof is the trouble class, measured twice 2026-09-14)

decisions.text: The learning tree over recurring gaps is a child cast after ten rehearsal records exist; v1 records gaps and learns nothing.
decisions.by: Akien verbatim 2026-09-15: 'This is how to train a learning block to produce effective tickets' + CC's reading accepted: a tree trained on zero verdicts is the hollow learning the chart chain measured at 0.00

decisions.text: D6 AMENDED (open-d71a52522428): a rehearsal step is named from the closed vocabulary the ticket itself provides — `D<n>` for the decision the step builds, or `unlisted: <text>` when the reader needs a step no decision covers. `unlisted` is a fifth gap kind: an unlisted step is itself a gap the ticket owes a decision for. validate() refuses a step outside the pattern and a `D<n>` the ticket's decisions[] does not carry (a re-read, like any schema lack); gaps() and the fold work on ids, so three readings converge by construction; the divergence resolves `D<n>` to the decision's text before tokenising. --decide takes the same vocabulary. Prompt: one node per decision a builder would carry out; a measurement or a ruling gets no node; never invent a D<n> the list does not carry.
decisions.by: Akien verbatim 2026-09-15 (answer to open-d71a52522428): 'i am trying to move us AWAY from free text. Free text of a plan, lets say, consumes more tokens than the same plan in the form of all decisions resolved, and the results in json.' — CC's reading applied the same day; measured on the live fire that bore the question: 46 gaps on this ticket, 39 step_absent, three wordings of one step under free text.

decisions.text: render(ticket) hands the reader ONE text: prompt.md, then the ticket file verbatim in a json fence under '# THE TICKET', then each standing chart berth (chain_for_ticket) verbatim under '# THE CHART', then the charters orient ref'd; no repository, no code. The reader is a callable (prompt_text, schema_doc) -> (tree | None, meta) injected as rehearse(ticket, reader=...); claude_reader is the default and the only live one.
decisions.by: CC 2026-09-15, measured from the build: the code as built is the decision, disposed from rehearsal pass 2 (rehearsals/cf80bdb57205-20260915T224633.json)

decisions.text: The lane is _sieve_lane('the_ticket_rehearses_clean', ...) in transitions.inspect_entry beside the four standing BUILDME lanes, wrapping build_inspector's buildme_rides_the_rehearsal exactly as the_ticket_names_its_sorted_door_firing wraps buildme_rides_the_sorted; test_transitions.py's lane teeth count five.

decisions.text: /sail step 0c is a loop over 'cairn rehearse <ticket>': a pass either writes a clean record and points the ticket at it (the lane then reads green) or prints the gaps for disposal by --decide or by a question; nothing is disposed automatically; the sixth pass opens one question and the ticket rests at BUILDME:waiting under the lane. There is no error exit — the lane IS the disposition.

decisions.text: record_divergence(ticket, proofs) at the CLI (cairn rehearse <ticket> --proved <proof.py>...), fired at the /sail close after the seal: steps = the clean record's first read with D<n> resolved to the decision's text; teeth = the def test_* names in the proof files given; a step is covered when a tooth shares two significant tokens with it; {steps_unproved, teeth_unforeseen, matched, proofs, at} is written as the record's 'divergence' through the door with verb rehearse. The probe reads records carrying a divergence and writes none.

decisions.text: The proof's fixtures are inline in test_rehearsal.py: a fixture ticket carrying D1 (write the widget) and D2 (prove the widget), CLEAN_TREE, GAPPY_TREES (one unlisted wiring step read three ways plus a lint step one read alone sees), a stale-hash case; the reader is injected as rehearse(ticket, reader=Stub([...])), the Stub cycling its trees per read; the proof runs under CAIRN_ARTIFACT_ROOTS over a temporary commons and never the live one.

decisions.text: prompt.md is the one prompt and it says: the job is the tree, never code (D2); the input is the text handed and nothing else (D4); one node per carried decision, by id, and 'unlisted: <text>' for a step no decision covers (D17); the three states, cannot_proceed a correct answer; no prose outside the JSON. The proof asserts the prompt carries each of these and that schema.json mirrors validate().

decisions.text: No fallback transport. A missing claude CLI, a non-zero exit or a timeout is caught into the read's attempt meta as a lack and the read is re-read like a schema failure; after RETRIES_PER_READ the pass raises ReaderFailed and writes nothing (Law 7: loud, never a coherent shape over an error).

decisions.text: A significant token: fold(text) (cairn.tools.system_word) with underscores as spaces, split on [a-z0-9]+, dropping tokens of one character and the stop list {the a an and or of to in is it its for on with test that not by as at be from this no one into}. Two tokens shared = len(tokens(step) & tokens(tooth)) >= 2, exact after folding; overlap is a parameter of divergence() defaulting to 2.

The probe's carry is the counts (proved, empty) and the per-ticket rows it measured.

intention: A ticket is measured buildable before it is built: the cheapest model reads the ticket plus its prebuild three times cold, returns a typed build tree, and the BUILDME crossing is held until the three trees agree and every gap has become a decision on the ticket or a question in the inbox.
why: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured — a ticket's buildability was a self-report by its own author); Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass, and a hollow green is worse than a red — so the gate's own greens are diffed against the real build); Law 4 (the hold is a BUILDME entry lane, physics, not a skill paragraph); Law 9 (measurement outranks his approval — a rehearsed-clean ticket needs none); Telos: Akien 2026-09-15 'that gives us almost a hard gate on ticket quality equal to me ... i don't have to approve them because we know they'll build as we meant.'
how: A new machine cairn/machines/rehearsal: (1) render the ticket and its standing chart berths as the reader's only input; (2) call Haiku 4.5 through `claude -p --model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 --output-format json` (measured working 2026-09-15, $0.04 a call) with a prompt whose job is the TREE, not code — every node carries state in {builds_as_written, builds_under_assumption, cannot_proceed}, the assumption, what would settle it, and confidence; cannot_proceed is a right answer; (3) run three reads that never see each other; (4) diff the trees by code — a node not builds_as_written in any read, a step present in one read and absent in another, or assumptions that differ are gaps, deterministic; (5) each gap is disposed by CC: derivable from an intention, charter or prior ticket → a one-line decision written onto the ticket with provenance; not derivable → `cairn question open --ticket`; then re-read; (6) a clean rehearsal (three reads, zero gaps) is written to CairnCommons/rehearsals/ through the artifact door, the ticket points at it, and a fifth BUILDME entry lane the_ticket_rehearses_clean (a build_inspector sieve composed in transitions.inspect_entry) refuses the crossing without one whose ticket hash still matches; (7) after PROVED the built proof is diffed against the converged tree — a divergence is the gate's own false green and is recorded on the rehearsal (the WATCHME). The learning tree over recurring gaps is a child cast later, once verdicts exist.
falsifier: DONE when, measured by cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/ with the reader stubbed by a fixture that returns recorded trees (the live Haiku call is the live fire, never a proof tooth): (1) three recorded trees that disagree on one step yield exactly one gap naming that step; three that agree yield zero; (2) a gap answered as a decision line changes the ticket hash, and a re-run against new agreeing trees writes a clean rehearsal record through the artifact door; (3) transitions.inspect_entry lists a fifth lane the_ticket_rehearses_clean, red for a ticket with no rehearsal, red for one whose recorded ticket hash no longer matches, green for a clean current one; a BUILDME crossing is refused by that lane's name; (4) the prompt text asserts the reader's job is the tree and that cannot_proceed is a legal answer (a tooth reads the prompt); (5) the post-PROVED diff writes a divergence list onto the rehearsal record; (6) live fire: `cairn rehearse` over a deliberately underspecified fixture ticket with the real reader returns gaps in all three reads, and over one of the 2026-09-14 residue candidates ends clean or in questions. WRONG INTENT: over the first ten real tickets Opus diverges from the converged tree as often as from un-rehearsed tickets.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured — a ticket's buildability was a self-report by its own author); Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass, and a hollow green is worse than a red — so the gate's own greens are diffed against the real build); Law 4 (the hold is a BUILDME entry lane, physics, not a skill paragraph); Law 9 (measurement outranks his approval — a rehearsed-clean ticket needs none); Telos: Akien 2026-09-15 'that gives us almost a hard gate on ticket quality equal to me ... i don't have to approve them because we know they'll build as we meant.'
